notes.title: Update 1.08 - The Atlantis Project!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today we add our second post release crew! The Atlantis Project is a noble force of aquatic avengers, hydrated heroes and lubricated legends. They fight for the seas, and all who treat the water with respect.

You'll get to unlock this new crew via their own FMV campaign, hosted by the awesome Alanah Pearce. Via an intriguing story, you'll learn to use their powerful Submerge skill, and take it into daily challenges, countdown and skirmish modes.

We're incredibly excited to be bringing this new crew to the game, alongside its release on the Nintendo Switch. Thank you so much for your continued support, and for keeping those leaderboards populated. We couldn't have imagined how well this little game would connect, and we're so damned excited to have you here.

Bug Fixes

 A couple of minor bug fixes and typos, but the game remains pretty darned stable.

New Features

 Our second Recruitment campaign is in, with The Atlantis Project as a reward.
  Daily challenges will now occasionally include The Atlantis Project, if you've unlocked them.


Have fun!

Cheers,

Mike

notes.title: Update 1.07 - TLC
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's time for our first update of 2021! The TLC update is all about the little things, tweaks and quality of life improvements designed to enhance your experience with the game, and address some of the feedback we've received, along with other imperfections we've spotted.

Here's a list of what's included:

Bug Fixes
The usual typo solutions (folks found a couple in The Merry!) and other small bugs.

Features

 Korean language support. Welcome, Korean players!
 Bloom can now be switched off in settings.
 Tooltips can now be toggled off outside of campaign missions.
 Skip button added to card dealing animations.
 Optional 60fps targeted frame rate cap for folks playing on high end graphics cards.
 Countdown timer and sound effects update for a little more drama at the end of a game.
 FMV codec update to make emulator play on Linux a little easier (platform is still not officially supported).
 Minimalist card mode available in settings for higher legibility.

Planned Features for Next Update
We're still finalizing the date, but this summer we'll be releasing the Atlantis Project, a new mini campaign with FMV and our tenth crew!

Cheers,
Mike

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791479/00f5c6e76a9343f9bb1026d3ce059531f2446076.png

notes.title: Update 1.06 - Return of the Merry!
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's time to add our first post release crew! The Merry are joining the game today, with their recruitment missions already on your map (and playable in standard or plus mode). By completing their mini campaign, complete with its own bespoke FMV cutscenes, you'll unlock them for dailies, countdown and skirmish. The Merry are returning characters in the Bithellverse (trademark definitely not pending), a modern update of Robin Hood and his Merry Men, first introduced in our 2015 game, Volume.

The Merry's power is one of redistribution, draining power from any crew they're placed on, and redistributing it at random, hopefully to cards more useful to your current situation. We think they'll add even more tactical depth to your play.

Hope you enjoy them and their story, definitely let us know if you run into any bugs or issues, and happy holidays! We're excited to share future plans in the new year... expect a new roadmap from us in late January.

Bug Fixes
More typo fixes, support for Big Sur (new Mac OS). Let us know if you run into anything new, and we'll get it solved.

New Features

 Our first Recruitment campaign is in, with The Merry as a reward.
 Daily challenges will now occasionally include The Merry.

Planned Features for Next Update
We're going to be taking our holiday breaks, but will fix any bugs as they're found. We'll return at the end of January with our next roadmap, but in the meantime, definitely let us know what you'd like to see more of.

Cheers,

Mike
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791479/a5d77127146660be9b82d2dd939c41622d81b728.png

notes.title: Update 1.05 - Global Spycraft!
notes.notes:
Hello!

OK! Here we go, our biggest update yet, and one that's essential to our more fiendish long term plans: We just rebuilt the game's main menu from the ground up. This new version charts your current place in the campaign, skirmish and countdown on a world map. This gives us more room for expansions to the game, and more content / modes.

The first of these modes are daily challenges. A locked layout skirmish style map is presented each day, with a leaderboard to compete with the world for the lowest number of turns. Daily hotspots will cycle at random, meaning you may have to fight to maintain your legacy placements. We wanted to add a competitive option for those who favour tactics over speed, and we're excited to see how folks get on with it.

Have fun, let us know how it goes, and if you're digging the game and our additions, be sure to leave us a Steam review heading into the holiday period. See you next month for our first new crew since launch.

Bug Fixes
We fixed some typos, and continue to solve bugs shared on our forums, so please do continue to let us know if you run into issues.

New Features

 Complete menu redesign for map support.
 Daily hotspots unlock when you have the crews required, providing competitive tactical play each day.


Planned Features for Next Update - Return of The Merry
(This drops December 8th)

 A new mini campaign with its own FMV (we shot it yesterday!!) and music...
 ...Unlocking a new crew, The Merry, for use in Daily Hotspots, Skirmish and Countdown.


Cheers,

Mike

notes.title: Update 1.04 - Gallery mode!
notes.notes:
Hello!

So, our latest update is a much requested gallery mode, featuring all the characters you've unlocked so far. This mode removes visual effects and let's you enjoy Jen's awesome work in full screen glory. Hope you dig it!

Bug Fixes
More little things here and there, a couple typos and some button weirdness. The game remains pretty darned stable, so please do continue to let us know if you spot anything odd.

New Features

 Gallery mode.
 A slightly too busy main menu screen worthy of some tweaks in our next update...


Planned Features for Next Update - Global Spycraft
(This drops November 19th)

 New global map screen to replace main menu and allow for expanded content.
 Daily Tactical Engagements.


And finally, thanks to Cyberpunk 2077 moving its release to our planned release for The Return of The Merry major update, we're gonna pull that a little earlier to December 8th, so as to give it a little breathing room before Cyberpunk takes over the internet.

And finally, if you're having a good time with the game, please do leave a Steam review. Those numbers help the game continue to find an audience! You've all been fantastic with that so far.

Cheers,

Mike

notes.title: Update 1.03 - Campaign Plus adds some challenge
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's update time again, an update that jumped the queue and made it in before our planned one in a couple of weeks. As we mentioned in our last news post, we wanted to get a more challenging alternative to Campaign into the game ASAP, and here it is!

Campaign Plus can be selected at the start of the Campaign, or toggled on and off at any time on the Campaign screen. Put simply; it turns every mission into a fixed puzzle. We've set up a par turn count per job, and locked a card layout. If you can't get a mission done in the turn limit we set, you'll fail and have to restart. This mode encourages power use and tests your skills, so is intended primarily for folks on their second play-through, or for whom the campaign feels too easy. We hope you'll dig it!

Bug Fixes
Some minor ones across the board, but nothing major to report. Please continue to let us know if you run into anything... odd.

New Features

 Campaign Plus: Play puzzle variants of all campaign missions.
 Full localization added for this and previous update's content.


Planned Features for Next Update
(I still need to take that break, so this should be dropping in a couple of weeks)

 Artwork Gallery.
 November Roadmap.

notes.title: Update 1.02 - Skirmish Enhancements and Big News
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's time for our next update, and this one's a bit more substantial... fixing a couple of quality of life issues, and fleshing out Skirmish Mode a little more. Full list below, but first...

Folks, The Solitaire Conspiracy's shifting some units. It's our bestselling launch yet. We've made a decision: We're gonna go to regular updates on this one. We're figuring out the roadmap, but you can expect a steady stream of content and tweaks for the game over the coming months, and communication from us on what's coming (and roughly when). We have a lot of ideas, but I'd love to hear anyone's thoughts on what they'd like us to invest time in adding to the game. Let's call this first phase 'stage setting'.. fixing issues and making the core game the best it can be before we start adding new modes and/or crews.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a misleading XP notification in results screen, text now matches your actual XP earnings.
Improvements to double click feel for sending cards to target... also, right mouse button now duplicates that functionality, with zoom on middle click (and is re-mappable via settings).


(Please let us know if you encounter any new bugs with this build.)

New Features

Skirmish and Campaign screen now feature tooltips showing you which crew is which, and reminding you of their powers.
Skirmish screen also has a randomize button, for those who'd rather have the game figure out a weird deck for them.
Mouse button remapping in settings (apologies to international players, this is not yet localized).


Planned Features for next update
(I'm taking a much needed post release holiday, so expected last week of October.)

Artwork gallery.
Roadmap for upcoming month.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Our first patch is up! 1.01 adds a feature we saw a few people asking about.. zoom!

Right click to zoom in, click again to zoom out. This should give you a better look at cards, and hopefully help those for whom small text is hard to read to enjoy the game's story a little more.

No major bug fixes, looks like we've had a pretty stable launch! Thanks so much for playing, and if you'd like to help us out, definitely drop a steam review for the game.

Cheers!

Mike
